correctness.rationale: Reconstructed from actual RESULT.md for every beta,gamma,tau,n>0 and compact shift-invariant law on complete strictly positive bounded solutions. Differentiation of invariant E[G(X)] for arbitrary continuous G’ gives E[dot X|X]=0, hence E[f(B)|X]=(gamma/beta)X; shift invariance equates B and X marginals. Since E[X/(1+X^n)]=(gamma/beta) E[X] and X>0, beta>gamma. Under size bias dQ=X dP/E[X], E_Q[(1+Y)^(-1)]=q with Y=X^n, q=gamma/beta and a=(1-q)/q, yielding the stated exact pointwise decomposition and strict equality criterion. Orthogonality of dot X to X gives Cov(X,f(B))=q Var(X); expanding beta f(B)-gamma X, with matched marginals, yields E[dot X^2]=beta^2 Var(f(X))-gamma^2 Var(X). A zero remainder or zero speed forces X constant at all rational times by invariance and then all times by continuity. No ergodicity or claimed non-equilibrium existence. Exact symbolic independent checks validate the pointwise rational decomposition and covariance algebra; they are not substitutes for the analytic generator step.

evidence: The full exact rational squared remainder gives a strictly positive scale-normalized deviation whenever any non-equilibrium compact positive stationary law exists.
The activity equality converts one-time production and population variances to E[dot x^2] exactly; this is not determined by ordinary variance alone.
The 2026 invariant-measure paper §§2-3 motivates one-time stationary marginals of this particular deterministic model.
value.rationale: The Mackey–Glass delay equation is a canonical nontrivial recurrent model; its one-time marginal distribution is a natural observable in invariant-statistics simulations. The inequality E[X^(n+1)]/E[X]>=x_*^n is an all-parameter sharp high-moment constraint with explicit squared non-equilibrium excess, and the second formula identifies an exact, nonnegative speed/production-variance diagnostic accessible without lagged samples. Together they give equilibrium rigidity for any invariant mixture and distinguish variability from temporal activity. The result is narrow and elementary and does not establish invariant-law existence, a new dynamical regime or a general theory; its mathematical value lies in the exact two-part stationary constraint for this nonlinear feedback, not in a new generic generator method.
residual_risks: The derivation is very short and shares machinery with prior published SCOPE stationary-calibration examples; independent value is modest.
The theorem constrains hypothetical/known compact invariant laws but does not supply existence, uniqueness or a nontrivial parameter regime.
